_meta.rule: extract.<view>:<storey> = THAT storey alone sliding out of the facade toward the camera; rev = the same clip reversed (the way back). An entry with contract "push-doll" (v11, the reel's technique) starts on the push-in END frame - img/<view>.jpg cropped at rect [x0,y0,x1,y1] (still px, 16:9; the page's 2D push on that storey ends there at a 16:9 viewport, pushCam/pushScale, scale = the push factor) - and ends on its dollhouse still `end` (img/doll/doll-<storey>.jpg, full 16:9 frame): the page plays it full-frame after its push and hands over to the dollhouse at that framing. An entry without a contract = the older one: frame 1 = img/<view>.jpg exactly, played over the pushed plate. status "cut" (no src) = the judge rejected every take: the page dissolves. null / absent = not rendered yet: the page extracts the storey in 2D from its own pixels (BuildingView.stageX). switch = parsed, not played (the view switch is a light dip). "final" entries are never replaced by tools/demo-sequences.mjs.

front:3.start: img/front.jpg cropped at rect (the page's push-in end frame)
front:3.pushTo: rect (cover-fit to the viewport): the clip's frame 1 is exactly this rect of the still; push to it whenever this clip plays
front:3.rectFrom: authoritative: the clip was cut at this rect; the page pushes to it (BuildingView.rectCam) whatever pushCam says
